tools.name: search_esim_plans
tools.description: Find eSIM-Global.VIP eSIM plans for a destination (country or region). Returns the best-value plans sorted by eSIM-Global.VIP Data Rating, with prices and a direct link. Use when a user wants mobile data abroad.

tools.name: get_plan_details
tools.description: Full details for one eSIM-Global.VIP plan by product id: data, validity, network, top-up support, transparency, reviews and link.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Hand the customer to the eSIM-Global.VIP shop to buy one plan. Returns buy_url (the product page where they tap Buy now to pay securely — card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, with an optional discount code) plus the plan name and price.
